hits.about: Oasis Residences One, a prestigious development by Reportage Properties that offers a mix of studios, 1, 2 & 3-bedroom apartments located at Masdar City, Abu Dhabi. This 9-story residential development consists of 612 apartments offering a choice of townhouses on the ground level and sky homes on the upper floor, some of which have their own large private terrace and plunge pool.These exceptionally designed apartments feature a limited number of two-level duplexes showcasing an innovative design-the first of its kind residential development in Abu Dhabi region. While allowing you instant connectivity options through its well-connected roads network and provides easy access to Abu Dhabi International Airport and all the entertainment areas and attraction of Yas Island.The development exteriors are designed with efficient energy reduction while at the same time it offers attractive and unique aesthetics. Quality insulations are used together with high thermal resistance glass and the finishing materials International aluminium cladding in various harmonised grey colours and the balconies are made with tempered security glass providing seamless views to the scenic surrounding.While its communal ground level features landscaped recreational areas with a swimming pool, gymnasium, kids play areas and barbecue areas. Each unit has their own private terrace or balconies and fully equipped kitchen.
